standard.summary: latent 磁盘缓存保存精度。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.auto: 缓存精度跟着运行时走。
optionDescriptions.fp16: 半精度缓存，盘和读写都省。
optionDescriptions.bf16: BF16 缓存，范围比 fp16 宽一点。
optionDescriptions.fp32: 全精度缓存，又大又准，对着用。

standard_en.summary: The precision the latent disk cache is saved at.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.auto: The cache precision follows the runtime.
optionDescriptions.fp16: A half-precision cache: easier on disk and on IO.
optionDescriptions.bf16: A BF16 cache, with slightly wider range than fp16.
optionDescriptions.fp32: A full-precision cache: large and exact, for comparison.

advanced.principle: latent 磁盘缓存保存精度。auto 会尽量保留运行时 dtype；fp16 更省空间，fp32 兼容性更高。若选择 npz + bf16，后端会自动回退为 fp32

advanced_en.principle: Precision for the on-disk latent cache. auto keeps the runtime dtype where possible; fp16 saves more space, fp32 is more compatible. With npz + bf16 the backend automatically falls back to fp32.
